# Photographed chroma-key test fixtures

Copyright Blender Foundation / Mango Open Movie Project contributors.
The three PNGs are modified technical-validation derivatives of the original
Tears of Steel green-screen footage, licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
See the [legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode).

Original source URLs, byte identities, numbered revisions, exact modification
scope, unknown source timing, colour conversion and original linear ranges are
in `source.json` and the repository `ATTRIBUTION.md`. The original EXRs remain
unchanged in external acceptance records; they are not bundled here.

These fixtures serve automated technical compositing validation. They are not
product artwork. Upstream separately notes that actors retain portrait and
privacy rights; this repository does not authorize advertising use of their
likenesses. The repository MIT license does not replace this footage license.
